title: Stranded Crew
text: A mining crew is broadcasting an open distress loop from a dead rock nobody else is coming for. Captain wants a call before we're in range to help.

outcome.text: They come aboard rattled and grateful. One of them, it turns out, can still fly.

choices.text: Give them fuel and coordinates, keep moving.

outcome.text: We hand off what we can spare. They'll make it to a depot on their own.

choices.text: We can't spare the detour. Leave them.

outcome.text: The Captain logs the coordinates and says nothing else about it.

title: A Compact Deserter
text: A Compact pilot is hailing us on an unencrypted channel, offering hardware in exchange for passage out of the cordon. Could be real. Could be a trap.

choices.text: Take the weapon, let them go.

outcome.text: The hardware checks out clean. Whoever they were, they're someone else's problem now.

choices.text: Turn them over to the nearest Relay outpost.

outcome.text: The outpost pays a finder's fee. The Captain doesn't look happy about it.
We never find out if it was real.

title: A Colony Asks for Supplies
text: A colony still holding out is asking us to leave what supplies we can spare instead of taking them aboard. It'll cost us, and it won't save them for long.

outcome.text: It buys them weeks, maybe months. The Captain says it was worth it. He always says that.

choices.text: We need everything we're carrying. Keep moving.

outcome.text: The channel goes quiet before anyone says goodbye.

title: A Live Reactor
text: A derelict frame is still hot — reactor core intact, and worth salvaging if we're careful. If we're not, it's someone's hull full of shrapnel.

outcome.text: The core comes free, along with the rest of the frame. Not without cost — something took damage getting it out.

choices.text: Strip what's easy and leave the core.

outcome.text: Safer, smaller haul. Nobody gets hurt getting it.

choices.text: Detonate it before it cooks off on someone else.

outcome.text: It goes up clean, away from any traffic lane. One less hazard in the belt.

title: A Jammed Transmission
text: Something's broadcasting under heavy jamming nearby — could be a colony, could be Compact bait. Pushing the signal through will take a nerve everyone's short on.

choices.text: Boost the signal, force it through.

outcome.text: It clears just enough to confirm survivors. The squads feel it — that's worth something.

choices.text: Trace the source instead of decoding it.

outcome.text: We can't make out the message, but we know exactly where it's coming from now.

choices.text: Let it drop. Not worth the risk.

outcome.text: The signal fades on its own a few minutes later. Maybe it was nothing.

title: A Refugee Ship, Out of Fuel
text: A civilian transport is dead in the water, packed well past capacity and drifting toward a patrol lane. They're asking for fuel, not rescue.

choices.text: Give them fuel from our reserves.

outcome.text: It's enough to get them clear of the lane. Word of it travels faster than the ship does.

choices.text: Point them to the nearest depot and move on.

outcome.text: It's a longer route than they wanted to hear, but it's something.

choices.text: We can't spare it. Wish them luck.

outcome.text: The Captain stays on the bridge a long time after that channel closes.
